cases.name: every family this session left in /tmp is dropped
cases.cmd: for p in readbounds-seen catbounds-seen diffbounds-seen batching-nudge batching-tick delegation statuscheck; do : > /tmp/claude-$p-{{SID}}; done; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-*-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: the per-agent suffix is dropped too
another session's fresh leftovers are left alone
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-other-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'kept=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-other-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; rm -f /tmp/claude-batching-nudge-other-{{SID}}

cases.name: a leftover older than two days is purged whatever session wrote it
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-delegation-old-{{SID}}; touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/claude-delegation-old-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'left=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-delegation-old-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

cases.name: a family nothing registers is never touched
cases.cmd: : > /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}}; touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}}; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'kept=%s' "$(ls /tmp/claude-evalkeep-{{SID}} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
